proof_body:
by
  intro f U c hU hd hi hc h0
  have hcn := hU.mem_nhds hc
  have hfa : AnalyticAt ℂ f c := hd.analyticAt hcn
  set G : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => f z - f c with hG
  have hGa : AnalyticAt ℂ G c := hfa.sub analyticAt_const
  have htop : analyticOrderAt G c ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro ht
    rw [analyticOrderAt_eq_top] at ht
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hb⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (ht.and hcn)
    have hx : c + (ε / 2 : ℝ) ∈ Metric.ball c ε := by
      rw [mem_ball_iff_norm]
      simp [abs_of_pos hε]
      linarith
    have h1 := hb _ hx
    have h2 : f (c + (ε / 2 : ℝ)) = f c := sub_eq_zero.mp h1.1
    have h3 := hi h1.2 hc h2
    have : ((ε / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0 := by simpa using h3
    have h4 : ε / 2 = 0 := by exact_mod_cast this
    linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp htop
  have hderiv : analyticOrderAt (deriv f) c + 1 = analyticOrderAt G c := hfa.analyticOrderAt_deriv_add_one
  have hdne : analyticOrderAt (deriv f) c ≠ 0 := by
    rw [analyticOrderAt_ne_zero]
    exact ⟨hfa.deriv, h0⟩
  have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by
    rw [← hn] at hderiv
    by_contra hlt
    have hle : n = 0 ∨ n = 1 := by omega
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, analyticOrderAt (deriv f) c = m := by
      cases h : analyticOrderAt (deriv f) c with
      | top => rw [h] at hderiv; simp at hderiv
      | coe m => exact ⟨m, rfl⟩
    rw [hm] at hderiv hdne
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hdne
      simp [h]
    have : m + 1 = n := by exact_mod_cast hderiv
    omega
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hg0, hfg⟩ := hGa.analyticOrderAt_eq_natCast.mp hn.symm
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (g c) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0)
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_pow hn0] at ha
    exact hg0 ha.symm
  set q : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => g z / g c with hq
  have hqa : AnalyticAt ℂ q c := hg.div analyticAt_const hg0
  have hq1 : q c = 1 := div_self hg0
  have hslit : ∀ᶠ z in nhds c, q z ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
    apply hqa.continuousAt.eventually_mem
    rw [hq1]
    exact Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.mem_nhds Complex.one_mem_slitPlane
  have hlog : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => Complex.log (q z)) c := hqa.clog (by rw [hq1]; exact Complex.one_mem_slitPlane)
  set φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => a * Complex.exp (Complex.log (q z) / n) with hφ
  have hφa : AnalyticAt ℂ φ c := analyticAt_const.mul ((hlog.div analyticAt_const (by exact_mod_cast hn0)).cexp)
  have hφc : φ c = a := by simp [hφ, hq1]
  have hn' : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn0
  set h : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (z - c) * φ z with hh
  have hha : AnalyticAt ℂ h c := (analyticAt_id.sub analyticAt_const).mul hφa
  have hhc : h c = 0 := by simp [hh]
  have hhd : HasDerivAt h a c := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt h (1 * φ c + (c - c) * deriv φ c) c :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id c).sub_const c).mul hφa.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    simpa [hφc] using h1
  have hpow : ∀ᶠ z in nhds c, f z = h z ^ n + f c := by
    filter_upwards [hfg, hslit] with z hz hs
    have e1 : f z = G z + f c := by simp [hG]
    rw [e1, hz, smul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    simp only [hh, mul_pow]
    congr 1
    simp only [hφ, mul_pow]
    rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hn', Complex.exp_log (Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero hs), ha]
    simp only [hq]
    field_simp
  have hmap : Filter.map h (nhds c) = nhds (h c) := (hha.hasStrictDerivAt.congr_deriv hhd.deriv).map_nhds_eq ha0
  rw [hhc] at hmap
  have hgood : ∀ᶠ z in nhds c, z ∈ U ∧ f z = h z ^ n + f c := Filter.Eventually.and hcn hpow
  have hS : {w | ∃ z, z ∈ U ∧ f z = h z ^ n + f c ∧ h z = w} ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) := by
    rw [← hmap, Filter.mem_map]
    filter_upwards [hgood] with z hz
    exact ⟨z, hz.1, hz.2, rfl⟩
  have hprim := Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp n hn0
  set ζ := Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I / n) with hζ
  have hζ1 : ζ ≠ 1 := hprim.ne_one (by omega)
  have hζn : ζ ^ n = 1 := hprim.pow_eq_one
  have hS2 : ∀ᶠ w in nhds (0 : ℂ), ζ * w ∈ {w | ∃ z, z ∈ U ∧ f z = h z ^ n + f c ∧ h z = w} := by
    have ht : Filter.Tendsto (fun w : ℂ => ζ * w) (nhds 0) (nhds 0) := by
      have : Continuous (fun w : ℂ => ζ * w) := by fun_prop
      simpa using this.tendsto 0
    exact ht.eventually hS
  have hS3 : ∀ᶠ w in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {0}ᶜ, w ≠ 0 ∧ w ∈ {w | ∃ z, z ∈ U ∧ f z = h z ^ n + f c ∧ h z = w} ∧ ζ * w ∈ {w | ∃ z, z ∈ U ∧ f z = h z ^ n + f c ∧ h z = w} := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, nhdsWithin_le_nhds hS, nhdsWithin_le_nhds hS2] with w h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw0, ⟨z₁, hz₁U, hz₁f, hz₁h⟩, ⟨z₂, hz₂U, hz₂f, hz₂h⟩⟩ := hS3.exists
  have hsame : f z₁ = f z₂ := by
    rw [hz₁f, hz₂f, hz₁h, hz₂h, mul_pow, hζn, one_mul]
  have heq := hi hz₁U hz₂U hsame
  rw [heq, hz₂h] at hz₁h
  have : (ζ - 1) * w = 0 := by linear_combination hz₁h
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h' | h'
  · exact hζ1 (sub_eq_zero.mp h')
  · exact hw0 h'
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (c : ℂ), IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → Set.InjOn f U → c ∈ U → deriv f c ≠ 0
